title: Accounting Policies, Changes in Accounting Estimates and Errors
summary: Prescribes the hierarchy for selecting accounting policies and the retrospective/prospective treatment of policy changes, estimate changes and prior period errors, converged almost exactly with IAS 8.

bannerNotice.title: Ind AS – Closely Converged with IAS 8
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 8 reproduces IAS 8's hierarchy for selecting accounting policies, and its retrospective/prospective distinction for changes and errors, almost exactly. Section 11 covers the full comparison.
